off_chain_basis.note: PFP 2.0 was not a normal on-chain mint. Holders first ordered a $100 physical 'MetaZoo NFT PFP Box'; inside was a redemption for the PFP plus a small on-chain mint fee. The on-chain primary revenue (about $2k) captures only that mint fee, so it badly understates what holders actually paid. Measured from the real $100 box price against the current floor, a PFP 2.0 is far deeper underwater than the on-chain number suggests.
